# Sophyia

> Sophyia is a Swiss SaaS company building an intelligence orchestration platform: a multi-agent AI that makes several instances reason, debate and adjudicate before answering — "Beyond the Single Model". Data and inference run in Switzerland (Zurich). Answers come with a reasoning trail and the system is built to refuse when evidence is thin.

## FAQ (questions & answers)
- [Platform & multi-agent AI](https://sophyia.io/faq/platform.html): how the orchestration engine works, "beyond the single model", built to refuse.
- [Products](https://sophyia.io/faq/products.html): Sophyia Chat, The Beasts, nOOai.

- [Sovereignty & Swiss hosting](https://sophyia.io/faq/sovereignty.html): data residency in Switzerland, auditability, regulated markets.

## Products
- Sophyia Chat — business assistant (in production with paying customers).
- The Beasts — autonomous multi-agent workforce for enterprise, with audit trails and structured debate.
- nOOai — live multi-agent debate platform.

## Key facts
- Swiss company; data and inference hosted in Switzerland (Zurich); auditable; strict on sources.
- Works with frontier models; depth is architectural (the same model run in opposing roles — analyst, risk officer, contradictor, adjudicator).
- Targets decisions that carry consequences, where a confident wrong answer is the real liability.
